name: Pastel Dawn
desc: Soft peach-and-lavender daybreak sky with chalky drifting clouds, a fading morning star, and a horizon sun-glow that breathes as the light climbs.

style.doc: chalky matte wash / wet blooming watercolor / riso halftone dot sky (abstract) / posterized duotone bands / dark pre-dawn nocturne

act.doc: sunrise = light+warmth climb across sections; drift = steady day, clouds as pure weather
